facts.fact: INASA's 2022 health statistics yearbook tabulates the monthly reports of health centres entered in DHIS2 by region and health area: 1,747 of 2,073 expected reports entered (completeness 82.2%) and 947 entered on time (45.7%), with regional completeness from 47.3% in the Bissau autonomous sector (176 of 372) to 100% in Gabu and Quinara.
facts.system: Sistema de Informação de Saúde, através do DHIS2

facts.fact: The yearbook counts monthly reports, not reporting facilities: 2,073 health-centre reports were expected in DHIS2 in 2022 and 1,747 entered, against a public network it gives as 111 type C, 19 type B and 5 type A health centres; four health areas of Bissau (Missira, Pefine, Santa Luzia, Sintra Nema) show no reports expected or entered, and it does not say how many centres key their own reports.
facts.system: Sistema de Informação de Saúde, através do DHIS2

facts.fact: The yearbook, published by INASA for the Ministry of Public Health, says its source is the routine data of the Health Information System through DHIS2; its credits name the head of the SNIS as coordinator and regional SIS officers and SNIS staff as the data collectors, with data compilation by REDISSE project staff and analysis and drafting by WHO.
facts.system: Sistema de Informação de Saúde, através do DHIS2

systems.system: Sistema de Informação de Saúde, através do DHIS2
systems.country_label: Sistema de Informação de Saúde (SIS); SNIS
systems.owner: INASA, Ministério da Saúde Pública; SNIS head coordinates, regional SIS officers collect
systems.tiers: monthly reports of health centres (centros de saúde), by health area in all 11 health regions; consultations, hospital beds and admissions, notifiable diseases and programme data are tabulated from it
by region; 2022 completeness 75.2%, timeliness 44.5%; whether digital is not stated

note: Where reports are keyed is not stated, so no digitised fact. The yearbook's production was financed by the World Bank through REDISSE with WHO technical support; that is said of the yearbook, not of the system, so no finance fact. Its 'Exatidão' column is reports entered on time over reports expected.
